description:
`log` records activity entries against one of your enrollments, so you and the service's provider can see what a scheduled job or app did.

The gateway forwards a `POST /log` to the platform, which checks your key, resolves `X-UnitySVC-Enrollment` to one of your enrollments (shared, or your own), and stores each entry with its identity stamped from the key and the enrollment, never from the body. A request carries one entry or an array of up to 100: `level` (`debug`, `info`, `warn` or `error`), `message` (up to 1 KB), optional `attributes` (up to 4 KB of JSON) and `occurred_at`. An oversized entry is rejected with 413, never truncated, and one bad entry rejects the whole batch. Entries are kept for 90 days. `log` is free: nothing on this path is metered or billed.

POST JSON to `/log` with your UnitySVC key and the enrollment's code in `X-UnitySVC-Enrollment`, optionally with `X-UnitySVC-Run-Id` to group one run's entries. Read them back under **Activity** on the Enrollments page.
name: log
summary: POST log entries to `/log` with an enrollment's code, and UnitySVC records them in that enrollment's activity log. Free.
